+from pydantic import AliasPath, BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
+
+
+def test_construct_omits_envelope_used_by_nested_aliases_from_extras():
+    class Order(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        sku: str = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('envelope', 'sku'))
+        quantity: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('envelope', 'quantity'))
+
+    order = Order.model_construct(
+        envelope={'sku': 'A-100', 'quantity': 2, 'debug': 'internal'},
+        audit_id='evt-001',
+    )
+
+    assert order.sku == 'A-100'
+    assert order.quantity == 2
+    assert order.model_extra == {'audit_id': 'evt-001'}
+    assert order.model_dump() == {'sku': 'A-100', 'quantity': 2, 'audit_id': 'evt-001'}
+
+
+def test_construct_consumed_alias_path_root_can_leave_empty_extra_mapping():
+    class Shipment(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        destination: str = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('shipment', 'destination'))
+
+    shipment = Shipment.model_construct(shipment={'destination': 'warehouse', 'note': 'source only'})
+
+    assert shipment.destination == 'warehouse'
+    assert shipment.model_extra == {}
+    assert shipment.model_dump() == {'destination': 'warehouse'}
+
+
+def test_construct_reuses_one_alias_path_root_for_several_fields():
+    class Reading(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        sensor: str = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('packet', 'sensor'))
+        value: float = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('packet', 'value'))
+        unit: str = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('packet', 'unit'))
+
+    reading = Reading.model_construct(
+        packet={'sensor': 'temp-7', 'value': 21.5, 'unit': 'celsius'},
+        received_by='collector-a',
+    )
+
+    assert reading.sensor == 'temp-7'
+    assert reading.value == 21.5
+    assert reading.unit == 'celsius'
+    assert reading.model_extra == {'received_by': 'collector-a'}
+
+
+def test_construct_keeps_alias_path_root_when_lookup_does_not_match():
+    class OptionalMetric(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        value: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('metrics', 'missing'), default=0)
+
+    metric = OptionalMetric.model_construct(metrics={'present': 42}, batch='nightly')
+
+    assert metric.value == 0
+    assert metric.model_extra == {'metrics': {'present': 42}, 'batch': 'nightly'}
+
+
+def test_construct_regular_alias_still_removes_its_input_key_from_extras():
+    class User(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')
+
+        username: str = Field(alias='user_name')
+
+    user = User.model_construct(user_name='ada', role='admin')
+
+    assert user.username == 'ada'
+    assert user.model_extra == {'role': 'admin'}
+
+
+def test_construct_alias_path_with_ignored_extras_remains_ignored():
+    class Event(BaseModel):
+        model_config = ConfigDict(extra='ignore')
+
+        code: int = Field(validation_alias=AliasPath('body', 'code'))
+
+    event = Event.model_construct(body={'code': 204}, request_id='ignored')
+
+    assert event.code == 204
+    assert event.model_extra is None
+    assert event.model_dump() == {'code': 204}
